citations.assessment: The named Yochanan is explicitly Rav Safra’s brother and raises the objection about the festival offerings. The adjacent Yehudah bar Safra is a separate speaker.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015
